title: Quarterly hosted inference scenario mapping and OKR threads
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: create a compact, decision-oriented quarterly roadmap for the Hosted Inference + Model Catalog surface that maps three realistic customer scenarios (PLG rapid-onboarding, enterprise SLA migration, and regulated private deployment) to a set of prioritized initiatives and OKR threads. Scope: align PM/Eng/Design/Research on acceptance criteria, rollout cadence, canary gating, model pruning windows, and evaluation signals that feed the Optimize and Console surfaces. Out of scope: full engineering tickets for autoscaling implementation (handled in ENG) and low-priority UX polish tasks.
work_plan: Define three scenario playbooks with personas and success metrics by 2026-03-12
Prioritize initiative lanes (Availability, Cost, Quality) and assign leads by 2026-03-18
Draft canary gating and rollback rules for model swaps by 2026-03-25
Create evaluation prompt sets and baseline metrics (latency, p50/p95, hallucination rate) by 2026-04-02
Lock roadmap and publish public-facing Q2 commitments by 2026-04-10
milestones: 2026-04-02: Eval harness populated with baseline prompts
success_criteria: OKR thread 1: Reduce p95 tail latency for hosted API by 15% on PLG workload compared to baseline
OKR thread 2: Decrease per-token unit cost by 10% via batching and caching recommendations across three canonical prompts
OKR thread 3: Onboard two new model families into catalog with automated evals and canary policies
Operational criterion: Canary rollback rate < 2% during first 2 weeks of rollout
acceptance_criteria: Each initiative has a defined owner and at least one measurable metric
Canary gating spec includes automatic fallback and traffic split policy
Model deprecation schedule published 30 days before removal with migration guidance
Console surfaces include a cost delta view for proposed model swaps
stakeholders: Miguel Torres - Senior PM (lead for availability lane)
Dr. Priya Natarajan - Research (eval harness lead)
risks: Model deprecation impacts enterprise customers with pinned versions
Latency improvements conflict with aggressive batching that increases tail latency for short queries
Eval coverage misses edge-case prompts used by financial customers
Dependence on kernel selection improvements that are scheduled in ENG roadmap after Q2
mitigation_plan: Provide pinned-version templates and migration playbook for enterprise customers
Create short-query fast-path in serving runtime to preserve p50 while enabling batching for long queries
Expand prompt corpus with two customer-provided decks during onboarding
Insert gating dependency into rollout plan and mark high-risk items as preconditions to canary
notes_for_engineering: Define per-model traffic split defaults for canary: 5% -> 20% -> 50%
Implement telemetry hooks for model swap events with trace IDs to Console
Ensure experiment tags surface in billing traces for per-route cost delta analysis
notes_for_design: Add cost-delta visualization to model selection modal
Create a compact scenario switcher in the roadmap page to compare PLG vs Enterprise vs Regulated impacts
Design migration messaging templates for deprecation notices
notes_for_research: Assemble evaluation prompt sets with emphasis on instruction-following, safety, and domain fidelity
Provide benchmark notebooks and baseline metrics for new model families
Recommend automated regression thresholds for quality-monitoring alerts
